claim: Is there a way to watch youtube movies in HD on PC? - Reddit
summary: So I recently discovered that youtube only allows playback of movies up to 480p in the google chrome browser even though I purchased the movies in 720p. Is there any way to watch these movies at the 720p resolution while on a pc? From it sounds like, it will only play the max resolution if streaming from some kind of TV streaming device, or something along those lines.
